description: baseline: LightGBM with 60-trial Optuna TPO search (5-fold CV) — optimal for small tabular binary classification at N=891 with mixed numeric/categorical features

Enhanced feature engineering (ticket group size, title-based age imputation, WomanOrChild flag, cabin number, fare per ticket member) + added CatBoost with native categorical handling, ensembled 50/50 with LightGBM OOF predictions
Added Title-based age imputation, AgeIsNull flag, WomanOrChild and AgeSexMale interaction features, plus 5-seed LightGBM ensemble averaging to reduce prediction variance

Added XGBoost to ensemble (LightGBM leaf-wise vs XGBoost depth-wise creates complementary predictions), plus new features: TicketGroupSize, CabinNum, FarePclassRank, SexClass interaction; blend 5-seed LightGBM + 5-seed XGBoost OOF predictions 50/50

Added TicketGroupSize/IsTicketGroup (same-ticket group proxy), SurnameGroupSize (surname family proxy), CabinNum (numeric cabin ordinal), WCPclass interaction; added max_depth to Optuna HPO; switched ensemble from same-fold-different-model-seed to 5-repeat-5-fold CV (different fold splits per seed for true prediction diversity)

Added fold-aware cross-validated target encoding: FamilySurvRate (surname group) and TicketSurvRate (ticket group) computed with Bayesian smoothing (k=3) and LOO for training samples — families tend to survive/die together, making this one of the strongest Titanic signals not yet in the model

Added fold-aware target encodings for DeckSurvRate and PclassSexSurvRate (the strongest Titanic interaction: 1st class female ~97% vs 3rd class male ~13%), plus TicketGroupSize/SurnameGroupSize group count features and WCPclass interaction; increased Optuna to 100 trials

Added TicketGroupSize, SurnameGroupSize, IsAloneTicket (group count features that tell the model how reliable the survival rate encodings are), WCPclass interaction (WomanOrChild × Pclass captures 1st-class women ~97% vs 3rd-class women ~50%), max_depth to Optuna HPO for better regularization tuning, increased trials to 100, and expanded ensemble seeds from 5 to 7 for better variance reduction.

Added CatBoost (5-seed, 5-fold OOF, native categoricals + fold-aware survival features) blended 50/50 with LightGBM — algorithmic diversity from CatBoost's symmetric trees and ordered boosting vs LightGBM's leaf-wise growth should reduce ensemble variance beyond what multi-seed LightGBM alone achieves

Added fold-aware PclassSexSurvRate target encoding (6 Pclass×Sex groups with survival rates from ~97% to ~13%) as a third survival feature alongside FamilySurvRate and TicketSurvRate, keeping all other settings identical to exp 6
